title: Direct Connect
explanation: AWS Direct Connect establishes a dedicated private network connection from your on-premises data center to AWS. It bypasses the public internet, providing more consistent network performance and reduced bandwidth costs.
analogy: Direct Connect is like having a private road built directly from your house to the office — no traffic lights, no other cars, just a dedicated lane for your use.
keyPoints: Provides dedicated 1 Gbps or 10 Gbps connections (or hosted connections at lower speeds)
Bypasses the public internet for more consistent latency
Supports both private VIF (VPC access) and public VIF (AWS public services)
Takes weeks to provision — not suitable for urgent connectivity needs

examKeywords.definition: A dedicated private network connection from on-premises to AWS, bypassing the public internet for consistent performance and reduced data transfer costs.

commonMistakes: Not planning for the weeks-long provisioning time of Direct Connect
Forgetting to set up a VPN as backup for Direct Connect failover
